name: Chorizo and Chickpea Stew

ingredients.name: chickpeas
ingredients.original: 2 x 400 g tins chickpeas, drained and rinsed

steps: Warm the oil in a heavy saucepan and fry the chorizo over medium heat for 5 minutes, until it curls and releases its red oil.
Lift the chorizo out and cook the onion and capsicum in the spiced oil for 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and smoked paprika, stir for a minute, then add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they darken.
Return the chorizo with the chickpeas and stock, bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 25 minutes, until the stew thickens enough to hold a spoon upright.
Stir the spinach through until it wilts and season to taste.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving — the stew is better just below piping hot.
